propositions: RP-02 through RP-06 decisions from recovered 2026-08-16 janitor plan require evidence-backed architectural research and approval before becoming implementation stories.
Research must preserve prior intent, cover hard-won test behavior, resolve implementation-critical ambiguities, and document remaining maintainer choices via checkout-local decision briefs.
Each RP has specific focus: RP-02 binding atomicity/recovery, RP-03 outbound lifecycle/failure policy, RP-04 config/operation snapshot, RP-05 CLI routing, RP-06 plan-review policy and routing.
Behavior changes must be explicitly labeled as approved deltas rather than treated as invariants, and all claims must cite repository/test/historical evidence.
Investigation is read-only and checkout-local; no tracked repository files, production code, or implementation stories are modified until research completion and maintainer approval.
